summary: Iteration 8 verification of (a) actionable auth error strings in Register/Login (bug fix) and (b) 'ScribeCraft' -> 'Begin' + 'AI' -> 'interactive' rebrand. Backend: 56/56 pytest tests PASS (existing 49 + 7 new in test_rebrand_and_errors.py covering /api/ service name, register duplicate detail exactness, login wrong-pw detail exactness, bundle filename .begin.zip + README 'Begin bundle', import accepts both .begin.zip and legacy .scribecraft.zip, non-zip error mentions .begin.zip, and static grep 'Reset your Begin password' in auth.py). Frontend Playwright verified: <title>='Begin — Accessible Interactive Writing Studio', meta description contains 'Begin' + 'interactive' and NO 'ScribeCraft' or 'AI'; register-heading and login-heading both 'Begin'; register-error textContent EXACTLY 'That email is already registered' when re-registering admin@scribecraft.app; login-error textContent EXACTLY 'Incorrect email or password' with wrong password; /about renders with brand-name='Begin', footer contains 'Begin · Sensory-safe writing sanctuary', all six feature-card-0..5 present, no 'ScribeCraft' leak; after admin login, /write shows 'Begin' in sidebar, about-link-btn text is 'About Begin', WelcomeIntro renders (first word 'Welcome' captured on screenshot; second word 'Begin' per WORDS array). Frontend required a supervisor restart to pick up the updated public/index.html (dev server was serving cached title until restart) — flagging as informational, not a code bug.
critical_code_review_comments: readableAuthError in /app/frontend/src/lib/auth.jsx correctly prioritises backend detail verbatim, has explicit branches for ECONNABORTED (timeout) and Network Error, and a specific 5xx fallback — meets all four spec cases. Old formatApiErrorDetail is exported at line 94 for backward compatibility.
Backend 400 for duplicate register uses exact string 'That email is already registered' (verified with pytest test_register_duplicate_error_message).
Backend 401 for wrong password uses exact string 'Incorrect email or password' (verified with pytest test_login_wrong_password_detail_string).
Bundle export Content-Disposition contains .begin.zip; README.md inside contains 'Begin bundle' — legacy 'ScribeCraft' not present in bundle contents.
Bundle import happily accepts both .begin.zip and .scribecraft.zip suffixes (regression-safe); error message for non-zip mentions .begin.zip primary.
Reset email subject in /app/backend/auth.py:356 is 'Reset your Begin password' (grep-verified).

Internal identifiers left intact per spec: logger 'scribecraft.auth' / 'scribecraft.emailer', localStorage keys 'scribecraft_*', admin email domain scribecraft.app — NOT flagged as bugs (per E1's explicit instruction).

Frontend dev server did not hot-reload public/index.html changes (title/meta) until `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` — this is expected react-scripts behavior (public/index.html is baked at server start). Main agent should be aware that public/ edits require a frontend restart to appear on the preview URL.
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest suites create/cleanup TEST_-prefixed projects, characters, and registered accounts. Frontend Playwright did not create persistent data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rebrand + register/login error-message bug fix are fully verified end-to-end. When editing /app/frontend/public/index.html (title, meta, noscript), you MUST `sudo supervisorctl restart frontend` for the preview URL to reflect the change — hot reload doesn't cover public/. The register-error selector is [data-testid='register-error'] and login-error is [data-testid='login-error']; both accept exact-string assertions now. Internal scribecraft.* logger names, localStorage keys, and the admin email domain are intentional and must NOT be treated as bugs.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Register page threw the generic fallback 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' whenever /api/auth/register returned an error, because the old formatApiErrorDetail returned '' when it couldn't format the detail and the caller used the raw fallback. Fix (verified): new readableAuthError(err, fallback) inspects err.response.data.detail with the same formatter, and now: (1) returns the formatted string verbatim if non-empty (this catches the 400 'That email is already registered' path), (2) returns a specific 5xx string, (3) surfaces Network Error and timeouts distinctly. The Register/Login pages were wired to use it. Verified via curl + Playwright: 400 detail surfaces verbatim in [data-testid='register-error']; 401 detail surfaces verbatim in [data-testid='login-error'].
